admission.justification: Verifying reached artifact before replay prevents altered file or report link substituting another first assignment.

applicability: Unresolved saved launch with receipt and artifact references, including both new suffix and legacy prefix receipts.
conditions: handover_envelope_candidates and resolve_handover_envelope inspect both trailing-suffix and legacy-prefix candidate lines and require one unique recorded-line plus SHA-256 match.
Complete handoverFile is checked before handoverArtifact to preserve complete-file diagnostic priority.
When openingMessageArtifact is recorded, it is verified and preflighted alongside sibling handover files and restored from verified receipt bytes if missing.
exclusions: A receipt that records no complete hand-over or opening-message sidecar is restored by the recorded artifacts' rules alone.
Frozen detail snapshots are verified without regenerating from live source.
statement: A saved first message is sent only after all recorded launch files (handover text, complete handover JSON, optional step-up artifact, and optional opening-message sidecar) and frozen detail artifacts are checked through a shared structural boundary resolver that preserves complete-file diagnostic priority and accepts both trailing-suffix and legacy-prefix receipts: matching files stay untouched, lost files are restored read-only from verified receipt bytes after preflighting every target, and any unmatched, ambiguous, tampered, rebound, or symlinked target refuses the retry with receipt and files untouched.
title: Saved launch restore validates and recovers handover and opening files
